hints.title: Subsequence State Tuple
hints.text: Every prefix of a subsequence can be characterized by its current alternating sum and whether the next element will be added or subtracted.

hints.title: Dual Parity Tracking
hints.text: Maintain separate records for alternating sums ending at an even or odd length so the correct sign applies to the subsequent candidate.

hints.title: Bounded Product Updates
hints.text: Update maximum products for each reachable alternating sum state, discarding products exceeding the given limit.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: S: number of distinct reachable state tuples
complexity.notes: State compression over reachable alternating sum and sign pairs bounds transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subsequences requires checking exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing maximal products per state reduces combinatorial explosion.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track alternating parity and bound product values within limit.
